comment: Queries the canary runs every five minutes, with the answer each must give.  The answers hold for the pilot's four catalogs as of 2026-11-18;  change them when a catalog is replaced.

checks.name: row count, servs_cdfs
checks.query: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM servs_cdfs

checks.name: cone, allwise (58.6 million rows)
checks.query: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM allwise WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',45.0,-30.0,0.2))=1

checks.name: cone, fp_xsc
checks.query: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM fp_xsc WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',180.0,0.0,2.0))=1
